name: Al Astra
source:
"I wonder what it means to be a legendary adventurer..."

Her heart yearns for adventure...

A bright, bubbly NPC who aspires to be an adventurer. Al is found by [url=/c84006]Shiina[/url], malnourished and on the verge of death, and joins her party as they set off for Odyssia. Her boundless enthusiasm is somewhat peculiar for an A.I. character.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]

[spoiler]Her real name is Morikubo Hinata (森久保 ひなた).[/spoiler]
